title: GenAI Reflection
text: For this lab, I used GenAI assistance to understand the lab instructions, organize the website structure, draft page content, and check that the Quarto project follows the required GitHub Pages workflow.

title: GenAI Reflection
text:
How It Helped
GenAI was useful for breaking down the task into smaller steps:

Identify the required submission URL.
Create the Quarto website files.
Configure _quarto.yml with output-dir: docs.
Add multiple pages with meaningful content.
Render the project and prepare it for GitHub Pages.

It also helped improve the wording of the website so that the pages read more clearly and consistently.

title: GenAI Reflection
text:
What Was Challenging
The main challenge was making sure that the website was not only created locally, but also prepared correctly for deployment. For GitHub Pages, the rendered files need to be available in the docs folder, and the repository settings must point GitHub Pages to that folder.

title: GenAI Reflection
text:
What I Learned
I learned that GenAI is most helpful when I already understand the goal and use it to support the workflow. It can speed up writing and debugging, but I still need to verify the final result, understand the files that were created, and make sure the submission link points to the live website.

title: Data Visualization
text:
Interpretation
The chart shows how confidence can improve as a learner repeats a workflow: create a file, render it, inspect the result, fix issues, and publish the finished output. Even a small visualization can make a written reflection easier to understand because the reader can scan the trend immediately.

title: Data Visualization
text:
Design Notes
A useful chart should have:

A clear title.
Labels that explain what the values mean.
A scale that does not exaggerate the message.
A short written interpretation beside the visual.
